note: El Dorado Irrigation District campground on the west side of Hwy 88 (Carson Pass), across the road from Silver Lake, in boulder-strewn woods beside a creek; not the Forest Service's Silver Lake East. A tight fit: only sites 6, 8, 27, 28 and 40 take a 24-ft trailer or motorhome. Bear lockers at every site; water is sometimes shut off (off as of 2026). Nearest dump station is at Plasses Resort at the south end of the lake. --Claude
summary: EID pages (live 403, read via 2025/2026 Wayback) + FS page: $30 (+$15 extra vehicle, $25 senior/military/disabled), FCFS only, no hookups, 42 sites, max 24 ft (five sites), vault toilets, no showers/dump, potable water off in 2026, season mid-May..mid-Oct; note's 'west shore of Silver Lake' corrected; tight 24-ft limit and phone flagged.
flags: RIG FIT (keep, caveat): EID: 'A tight fit, so it is recommended that RV's or trailers do not exceed 24'. The following sites will accommodate a 24 foot trailer/motor home: 6, 8, 27, 28 & 40.' A 23-ft rig fits only those five sites; passes the ~23 ft rule, but on a busy weekend those five may be taken (first-come only).

EID's Silver Lake pages give only the e-mail recreation@eid.org (EID's recreation phone on its FAQ is the Sly Park Gate House (530) 295-6824). Suggest leaving the FS number or replacing with (530) 295-6824 - AWH's call.
